stamp: {"keys":[{"id":"k","problem":"A company's page lists its provident and study funds but not its index-tracking funds or money-market funds.","where":"the product choices at the top of the company page","kind":"general"}],"liked":[]}

raised: Unsure which product their money is in; the page opened on a preselected 'קופת גמל להשקעה' they didn't choose
The fee shown is an average ('ממוצע'), so their own fee may be different
The '123 ממקור / מחושב / הזנה' labels are confusing, and it's unclear why there are three kinds
Too many 'במה הכסף מושקע' filter buttons, which repeat what the table shows
'PF-10' is a confusing code
The extra direct costs are mentioned but their size isn't shown
Folded sections (קרנות מחקות, מרכזית לפיצויים, קרנות סל) are closed and it's unclear if they're relevant; would remove
The 'מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל' rows are all closed and don't say what's inside
Conflicting dates (September 2026 vs 03.11.2026); unclear which one counts
Most tracks show 'פחות מ־3 שנים', so there's no return information for them
The 'קופה' fund-code column means nothing to them; would remove
'מט״ח' isn't understood, and it can exceed the shares figure / add up to more than 100%
The rings in the table add nothing; would remove
Unclear whether the 3-year return is a yearly average or a total
Unclear what 'סחיר' means and how 'מניות סחיר' differs from 'מניות'
No cost in shekels for the percentage fee
No returns shown after fees and tax
No comparison with other companies
Nothing aimed at someone close to retirement (safer tracks, drawing a pension)
The 'לא מצאתם שם?' search box isn't needed; would remove

problems.why: The reader never says index-tracking or money-market funds are missing from the product choices; they only mention folded sections for קרנות מחקות and קרנות סל, which they skipped for a different reason.
